tools.name: diagnose_funnel_bottleneck
tools.description: Diagnose conversion bottlenecks using 2–10 named stage counts and an optional relative improvement percentage. Returns conversion rates, the lowest-rate transition, ranked final-stage gains and data cautions. 集客の改善候補を選ぶために段の名前・人数と改善率を入力し、通過率・最低の段・最後の人数の増分・注意点を返します。 Set language to 'en' for English o

tools.name: reverse_kpi_from_revenue_target
tools.description: Plan required volumes from a positive revenue target, unit price, 1–36 months and 1–8 ordered conversion rates. The target is for the whole period, not monthly. Returns rounded-up stage requirements, monthly averages and upstream reductions when each rate improves by 10% relatively. 売上目標の達成に必要な人数を整理

tools.name: check_business_plan_assumptions
tools.description: Review unit economics using acquisition cost, monthly customer revenue, gross margin and churn; optionally include growth and cash runway pairs. Returns lifetime gross profit, acquisition-cost multiple, payback months, optional projections and general reference cautions. 計画の前提を見直すために獲得単価・月売上・粗利率・月解約
